row.evidence: UKG publishes no SCIM documentation; Microsoft's UKG Pro tutorial says to "Work with UKG Pro support team to add the users in the UKG Pro platform", and UKG Ready plans are all "Get pricing".
row.notes: UKG is an HCM suite (UKG Pro, UKG Pro Workforce Management, UKG Ready); this row covers UKG Pro, the product with public developer docs and IdP catalogue apps, plus the UKG Ready plan list as the only published tier table. No UKG prices are public. As an HRIS, UKG Pro is normally the identity source: Okta's UKG Pro app imports users from UKG Pro and pushes profile updates back, but no IdP page or public UKG page documents creating or deactivating UKG Pro user accounts by SCIM. Entra's tutorial is SSO only and has users added by UKG support. UKG Pro's public API offers read-only user, security-user and role endpoints plus a SOAP Federated SSO User service that creates and updates SSO user mappings. Much of UKG's product documentation sits behind customer login, so this stays unknown rather than none.

limitations.text: Entra's UKG Pro tutorial has users created in UKG Pro by working with the UKG Pro support team; users must be created and activated before SSO.

Okta's UKG Pro integration is API-based (UKG web services URL, admin credentials, user and customer API keys) and lists importing users from UKG Pro and pushing profile updates, not creating or deactivating UKG Pro accounts.

rate_limits.text: API gateway quotas and rate limits per time window (normally 1 minute); exceeding them returns HTTP 429.

limitations.text: The public REST user and role endpoints are read-only (GET); no documented REST endpoint creates, deactivates or deletes a UKG Pro web user.
The Federated SSO User SOAP service manages the SSO identity mapping for an existing employee, not the employee or user account itself.
Webhook events are employee (HR record) events such as hires and terminations, not application-account events.

fallbacks.other_sync: UKG Pro acts as an HR source: Okta imports users and profile attributes from UKG Pro (profile sourcing) and can push profile updates back

open_questions: UKG publishes no SCIM documentation on its public sites; whether UKG Pro, UKG Pro Workforce Management or UKG Ready accept inbound SCIM for user accounts is not disclosed (much product documentation needs a customer login).
No UKG prices are public, and UKG Ready's plan page does not say which plans include SSO or API access.

The public REST user/role endpoints are GET only; whether any API creates, deactivates or deletes UKG Pro web user accounts (as distinct from employee records via the SOAP New Hire / Termination services) is not documented.
UKG Pro Workforce Management (formerly Kronos Workforce Dimensions) has its own Entra SSO tutorial and was not researched separately; the vendor may warrant splitting into product rows.
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue entries were not checked; SAML JIT and CSV import of users are not documented publicly.
Whether Okta can create UKG Pro accounts is unclear (see conflicts); the UKG Pro app is recorded as sso_only per Okta's feature table.
